reason: S1 introduces materially new LZMA/XZ dictionary-history behavior and a required work-buffer protocol, but H0's fuzz entry point exercises only wuffs_json__decoder and wuffs_aux::DecodeJson. Although LZMA/XZ were already outside H0 in S0, the commit materially aggravates that gap by adding the new decoder.add_history! ring-buffer state, changing decoder.transform_io? to preserve output through args.workbuf, and adding $short workbuf behavior that H0 cannot reach or control.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON, and fuzz dispatches only to fuzz_cpp, fuzz_complex, and fuzz_simple using wuffs_json__decoder or wuffs_aux::DecodeJson.
S1 adds decoder.add_history!, which mutates dict_seen and dict_workbuf_index and maintains a dictionary ring buffer in args.workbuf.
S1 changes decoder.workbuf_len from an exact zero-length range to dict_size + 273 when dict_size is nonzero.
S1 changes decoder.do_transform_io? to yield base."$short workbuf" until args.workbuf.length() reaches dict_size + 273.
S1 changes decoder.decode_bitstream_slow? so LZ copies can read historical bytes from args.workbuf when dist exceeds args.dst.history_length().
std/xz decoder.do_transform_io? changes from passing this.util.empty_slice_u8() to passing args.workbuf into this.lzma.transform_io?, extending the new protocol to XZ decoding.
recommended_action: Add or update project-owned LZMA/XZ fuzz coverage that initializes the relevant decoder, varies QUIRK_FORMAT_EXTENSION and compressed input, allocates work buffers according to decoder.workbuf_len(), exercises $short workbuf and suspension/resumption, and stresses dictionary wraparound and copies spanning args.workbuf and args.dst history.
